title: Targeting inflammation and redox aberrations by perindopril attenuates methotrexate-induced intestinal injury in rats: Role of TLR4/NF-kappaB and c-Fos/c-Jun pro-inflammatory pathways and PPAR-gamma/SIRT1 cytoprotective signals.
authors: Sayed, Ahmed M; Abdel-Fattah, Maha M; Arab, Hany H; Mohamed, Wafaa R; Hassanein, Emad H M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究培哚普利对甲氨蝶呤诱导大鼠肠损伤的保护作用，聚焦炎症与氧化应激通路，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: The use of methotrexate (MTX), a classical immunosuppressant and anti-cancer agent, is associated with multiple organ toxicities, including the intestinal injury. Components of the renin-angiotensin system are expressed in the intestinal epithelium and mucosal immune cells where they provoke pro-inflammatory and pro-oxidant action. The present study was conducted to investigate the potential ability of perindopril (PER), an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEI), to attenuate MTX-induced intestinal injury with emphasis on the role of the pro-inflammatory TLR4/NF-kappaB and c-Fos/c-Jun pathways alongside PPAR-gamma and SIRT1 cytoprotective signals. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The intestinal injury was induced by a single-dose injection of 20 mg/kg of MTX i.p at the end of the 5th day. PER was administrated once daily in a dose of 1 mg/kg, i.p, for five days before MTX and five days later. RESULTS: Herein, perindopril attenuated the intestinal injury as seen by lowering the histopathological aberrations and preserving the goblet cells in villi/crypts. These beneficial actions were associated with downregulating the expression of the pro-inflammatory angiotensin II, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 cytokines, alongside upregulating the anti-inflammatory angiotensin (1-7) and IL-10. At the molecular level, perindopril downregulated the TLR4/NF-kappaB and c-Fos/c-Jun pathways in inflamed intestine of rats. Moreover, it attenuated the pro-oxidant events by lowering intestinal MDA and boosting GSH, SOD, and GST antioxidants together with PPAR-gamma and SIRT1 cytoprotective signals. The aforementioned findings were also highlighted using molecular docking and network pharmacology analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Perindopril demonstrated notable mitigation of MTX-induced intestinal injury through suppression of TLR4/NF-kappaB and c-Fos/c-Jun pathways alongside the augmentation of PPAR-gamma/SIRT1 cytoprotective signals.
abstract_zh: 目的：甲氨蝶呤（MTX）作为一种经典的免疫抑制剂和抗癌药物，其使用与多器官毒性相关，包括肠道损伤。肾素-血管紧张素系统的组分在肠上皮和黏膜免疫细胞中表达，并在其中引发促炎和促氧化作用。本研究旨在探讨培哚普利（PER），一种血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂（ACEI），对MTX诱导的肠道损伤的潜在缓解能力，重点研究促炎性TLR4/NF-kappaB和c-Fos/c-Jun通路以及PPAR-gamma和SIRT1细胞保护信号的作用。材料与方法：在第5天结束时，通过单次腹腔注射20 mg/kg的MTX诱导肠道损伤。PER以1 mg/kg的剂量每日一次腹腔注射，连续五天在MTX给药前和给药后各五天。结果：本研究中，培哚普利通过降低组织病理学异常并保留绒毛/隐窝中的杯状细胞，减轻了肠道损伤。这些有益作用与下调促炎性血管紧张素II、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6细胞因子的表达，同时上调抗炎性血管紧张素（1-7）和IL-10相关。在分子水平上，培哚普利下调了大鼠炎症肠道中的TLR4/NF-kappaB和c-Fos/c-Jun通路。此外，它通过降低肠道MDA并增强GSH、SOD和GST抗氧化剂以及PPAR-gamma和SIRT1细胞保护信号，减轻了促氧化事件。上述发现也通过分子对接和网络药理学分析得到了强调。结论：培哚普利通过抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB和c-Fos/c-Jun通路，同时增强PPAR-gamma/SIRT1细胞保护信号，显著缓解了MTX诱导的肠道损伤。
